signal: Lambda raised over $1.5B Series E and signed multibillion-dollar GPU infrastructure deals with Microsoft and NVIDIA in 2026

email.body1:
Robert, saw Lambda closed a $1.5B Series E and signed the Microsoft and NVIDIA infrastructure deals this year.

Scaling that fast usually means more enterprise accounts in play than the team can cover before new reps ramp, and that is where deals go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Lambda off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Robert, quick follow-up for Lambda.

After a raise that size, board expectations on pipeline usually jump faster than headcount can. Most teams cannot say how many meetings they need to hit the new number, so the gap surfaces late and the quarter becomes a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Lambda needs to close that gap this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Robert, last bit of proof for Lambda.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Lambda's reply rate likely compares to other fast-scaling infra startups. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Robert, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount is not a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Right after a raise, timing is everything, and the fundraise-to-hiring stretch is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to an infra GTM motion? I will tailor it to Lambda either way.
